reason: The README describes a mobile remote-control interface for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI, including QR pairing, responsive phone access, and optional task-completion notifications.

summaries.zh: 通过一次性二维码将手机连接到 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面，并提供响应式远程操作和任务完成提醒。
summaries.en: Connects a phone to the DeepSeek Harness web interface with one-time QR pairing, responsive remote access, and optional task-completion alerts.

capabilities: Pairs a phone with the desktop web interface using a one-time QR code
Provides remote access to the normal responsive web UI
Plays task-completion chimes and browser notifications
Supports configuring a public origin through a reverse proxy or named tunnel
